scope: Targeted native DOS runtime, build, and installer validation. No complete campaign certification.

identity.release_difference: Only the hidden label changed from Paused: Show to Paused Show after behavioral testing. The final label was verified in a fresh native boot; restoring that single source string independently reproduces the tested behavioral executable exactly.

method.engine: Original DOS U7.EXE through the supplied ULTIMA7.COM launcher
method.evidence: Native VGA captures and bounded read-only guest-state samples from disposable game copies. Runtime instrumentation is not installed in the release. Original supplied files and saves were not used as mutable test fixtures.

ui.picker_cancel: T, M, and G canceled by Escape; G canceled by right-button press. Native cursor restored, previous orders retained, game time unchanged. R opens selected native equipment when the actual weapon does not match.

confirmed_regressions.name: Stale return-to-automatic schedule
confirmed_regressions.observed: Hold captured combat schedule 0. Native C ended combat and put Avatar on follow 31, but skipped held Shamino. Auto restored stale combat 0; Shamino pursued again and spider HP changed 9 to 6.
confirmed_regressions.repair: After actual native combat start/end calls, synchronize stored ordinary follow/combat policy. Combat end changes explicit Attack to Hold and clears its target while preserving existing Hold and Move.
confirmed_regressions.current_behavior_candidate_pass: Both actual C start/end transitions repeated; Auto restored native combat 0 after start and follow 31 after end.

confirmed_regressions.name: Avatar movement overwrites manual companion ownership
confirmed_regressions.reproduction_build: earlier combat candidate before movement hook
confirmed_regressions.observed: All eight actors had Hold. Ordinary right-mouse Avatar movement invoked the native party-wide follow reset, and a held Tseramed moved one tile while still owning a Hold record.
confirmed_regressions.repair: Guard the reset at resident 4:07AB. Preserve manual non-Avatar orders while allowing original reset for Avatar and Auto companions.
confirmed_regressions.current_behavior_candidate_pass: Avatar moved from (1662,1767) to (1672,1767); all seven held companions retained identical positions.

current_companion_acceptance.observation: All seven held companions stayed fixed.
Spark retained owned route 52328, advanced (1660,1765) to (1668,1772) to (1672,1776), then completed in Hold; six other held companions stayed fixed.
Spark followed from (1672,1776) to (1674,1774) during Avatar movement while six held companions stayed fixed.

Spark kept ranged target NPC 304 and native combat schedule 0 during Avatar movement. The target was later removed from the native NPC table; the order changed to Hold without selecting a different foe.
Hold followed by Auto restored native combat 0 after actual start and follow 31 after actual end.

observations: Actual native C end canceled a live Attack into Hold and cleared the target. An owned Move route and existing Hold orders survived the end.
With the Avatar held, Spark ranged attack changed the selected spider signed HP from 9 to -10 after two resumed seconds; the other seven held actors stayed fixed.
Avatar target command changed spider signed HP from 9 to -3; all seven held companions remained fixed.
Tseramed ranged attack consumed arrows 23 to 22 to 20; target removal changed the order to Hold. Final target HP was not sampled before removal.
Cold startup, paused active combat, generated target names and source reproducibility were checked.
Shamino melee with an equipped lightning whip changed spider HP from 9 to 1. Hold canceled the attack.
Confirmed in-place loading released an old owned Move route before native restore and cleared all nine command modes and route pointers afterward.
An actual native save serialized Spark with ordinary schedule 31 and attack quality 2, then restored the running Hold order. This save was subsequently loaded under candidate 6.
World shortcut and inventory disk SaveUI paths restored ordinary native policy while open and reapplied pending orders after closing.

limits: The exact user-reported offscreen regrouping and apparent teleport were not reproduced. Two concrete command-ownership bugs were reproduced and fixed.

The original automatic-follow catch-up path remains: resident 41:21BF checks follow schedule 31; offscreen recovery calls 249:0039 and native coordinate setter 86:1648. This is a static trace, not a measured teleport in these tests.
Runtime combat transition tests used native keyboard C. The other guarded script/dialog callers were statically audited but not separately triggered in a live scenario.

The original C key bases its start/end decision on the Avatar schedule. With the Avatar explicitly held, return the Avatar to Auto before using C to end ordinary combat. This release does not introduce a separate global combat-state model.

Saved games retain their native format. Loading starts with automatic orders; pending tactical orders are session state. Save/load observations from earlier candidates are labeled, not presented as newly repeated complete coverage.

Tests do not cover an entire campaign, every weapon, every quest transition, or every DOS configuration. Installer execution was tested on the Linux host; Windows/macOS command examples are provided but were not separately run on those hosts.
privacy_and_distribution: This public report includes derived observations only. It contains no guest RAM dumps, game executable, assets, or save files.

checks: pristine check: complete output verified; no game writes
pristine install: exact release hash; verified backup; saves/config retained
current version: idempotent install/check and direct executable path
uninstall: exact original restored; backup/save/config retained; repeat safe
v7 upgrade: existing local original recognized; old files and new progress retained
v7 missing backup: refused without writes; explicit verified original succeeds
unknown/modified executable: install/uninstall refused without writes
conflicting backup: check/install refused; both existing files retained
concurrent installer lock: refused before executable replacement
FAT/exFAT backup fallback: exclusive creation, verified backup, exact installed hash
replacement failure: original executable retained; verified backup and no stale lock
ZIP: CRC and every member hash passed; complete source and all public reports included
ZIP exclusions: no original/modified EXE, game resources, saves, images, private reports, test inputs or Python caches
fresh ZIP extraction: native source rebuild byte-equal to frozen executable
packaged generator: default ./source and optional report copying reproduce exact native output without caches
destructive output paths: source/ancestor/unmarked folder refused and retained
archive verification failure: prior ZIP retained before publication
distribution_build_validation.publication_note: The final archive was regenerated after these report fields were added. Runtime executable, native source, installer, and build logic remained identical; final member hashes and ZIP CRC were rechecked.
